Definition: Ard, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ard is named among Benjamin's sons who went down into Egypt with Jacob, and in the wilderness his descendants are numbered as the Ardites. The name is all that survives of him, yet it still marks a family that crossed from Egypt to Moab.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a name preserved through the wilderness count means God kept track of this family too, even when Scripture gives us nothing more than the name itself.
